headline.title: A cyberattack hits Poland’s e-government platform
headline.quip: The attack was “detected and stopped.” Restoration work, as is traditional for government IT, continued.
headline.summary: Poland’s ePUAP e-government platform was hit by a cyberattack. Minister Gawkowski said it was “detected and stopped,” but restoration work continued, and the Internal Security Agency (ABW) is investigating.
